_description: Image Preprocessing Stage - Step 3 of the FaceMed AI Pipeline

resize.description: All input images are resized to 64x64 pixels so the CNN receives a fixed-size tensor regardless of the original image dimensions.

normalization.description: Each pixel RGB value (0-255) is divided by 255 to produce a float in [0,1]. This stabilizes gradient descent during training and speeds up convergence.

colorSpace.description: Images are kept in RGB format. No color space conversion (e.g. LAB or HSV) is applied at the preprocessing stage.

tensorShape.description: Final tensor shape fed into the CNN: [batch_size=1, height=64, width=64, channels=3]
